causes.what: The load balancer itself is failing: it marked all 4 web backends unhealthy at 23:02:21 and returns 100% 5xx. The web tier is healthy, so the fault is in the lb, such as its health-check or backend configuration or its process. The lb has no metric that shows the exact mechanism.
The replica has a separate CPU saturation (about 94% since 22:47, with 27% IO wait). It started before the outage and shows no link to the shop outage.

unrelated_alerts: db-02: High CPU utilization (replica, started 22:47, about 15 minutes before the lb failure; db-01 primary is normal at 32% CPU, replication lag only 1.9s, and app db errors are 0)
evidence: lb-01 lb.backends.healthy dropped from 4 to 0 at 23:02:21 and lb.5xx.pct went from about 0.2 to 100 at 23:02:14
web-01 to web-04 are all healthy at the same time: http.5xx 0.02-0.37%, response time 430-510 ms, CPU 20-29%, reachable by ping
web-01 5xx stayed near 0.1-0.4% across 23:02, so clients' 100% 5xx comes from the lb, not from the backends
app-01, app-03 and cache-01 are normal: app.db.errors 0, app.version steady at 412 for 120 minutes (no deploy), cache hit 92.8%
db-01 is normal, and nas-01 (latency 3.6 ms), core-rtr-01, dist-sw-01 and dist-sw-02 show no errors or link-down; hv-01 CPU is 45%
lb-01 CPU is 25%, memory 54%, ping fine, so the host is up but its backend pool is empty
db-02 CPU jumped from about 25% to 96% at 22:47 and stays there, with db-02 slow-query rate unchanged (about 2/s)
